metadata.description: C++ qlat HMC test vectors for qlat_ref.hmc (GaugeMomentum.set_rand, gm_hamilton_node and full force-gradient trajectories)

exactness.integer: the RNG integer stream is bit-exact; not recorded here because tests/data/rng-vectors.json is its primary contract
exactness.float: values are compared to 1e-14 (momentum) and 1e-12 (trajectory field/plaq); the C++ and qlat_ref arithmetic is the same operation by operation, so the measured differences are a few ULP.  Full precision decimals are stored (repr of the double), so a regeneration can be compared bit for bit by hand, but the tests assert the tolerance, not bit equality.

metadata.maintenance_note: These vectors are a committed reference, not a snapshot to regenerate casually: regenerating them after an unintended change in qlat_ref would defeat their purpose.

gm_root_test_rng_sigma1.name: gm_root_test_rng_sigma1
gm_root_test_rng_sigma1.flat_ordering: index = ((site * 4 + mu) * 9 + (i * 3 + j)); site = index_from_coordinate(x, total_site) with x[0] fastest; matrix row-major p[i*3+j], matching ColorMatrixT::p
